topic: Are image transformers more or less sensitive to pixel noise than convolutional networks?

trace.plan: The experiment will compare the sensitivity of image transformers and convolutional networks to pixel noise using a custom dataset of images with varying noise levels. The dataset will be generated using PyTorch's built-in noise functions to ensure consistency and alignment with the plan. The models will be trained and evaluated on the same dataset, with noise levels systematically increased to measure performance degradation. The experiment will run on a single GPU and will focus on metrics such as accuracy and mean squared error. The plan will include a control condition with no noise to establish a baseline. The code will include all necessary imports and will be validated for execution before submission.
